faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PAU Project Assistant recruitment is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Agriculture/B.Sc. degree with a minimum OCPA of 6.00/10.00 basis or 60% marks. Additionally, proficiency in Punjabi up to Matric Standard and at least one year of relevant experience are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Assistant post is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month, which includes ESI and EPF contributions.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the PAU Project Assistant vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PAU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 150 for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. This fee needs to be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), which is https://pau.edu. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Project Assistant post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is E.2.2026/3613-23.
